## History

Young Mary Joe was left in charge of caring for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) while Mr. and Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) were away. When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) became severely ill with croup, Young Mary Joe panicked, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to seek help from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_
